title: Sincerity to Allah the Exalted in Raising and Educating Children

text_simplified: A parent must have sincere intention for Allah the Exalted in raising and educating his children; his concern should not be merely obtaining worldly degrees and positions detached from benefiting Islam and Muslims, but rather seeking Allah's reward and serving His religion. Likewise, a parent should be sincere in honoring his own parents out of obedience to Allah and desire for His reward, and should raise his daughter to respect, honor, and serve her parents as an act of worship and devotion to Allah the Exalted.
